measurement_procedure: Use one scale-matched flat, curved, boundary, noisy, and non-geometric family; construct intrinsic complexes, lengths, hinges, and dual volumes; measure dimension, distortion, metric conditioning, topology, curvature, boundary terms, and a held-out finer level.
uncertainty_procedure: Fit the frozen model on exactly four levels, propagate metric/curvature/boundary uncertainty, and predict the fifth before reveal.
statistical_analysis: Pass only with stable topology/dimension, decreasing errors at the frozen ratio, accurate fifth-level prediction, and zero geometric declarations on controls.
